Sure, here are two hints for the problem:

**Hint 1:** Consider the concept of linear dependence. If one column can be expressed as a linear combination of other columns, it does not add to the rank of the matrix.

**Hint 2:** Remember that the rank of a matrix is the maximum number of linearly independent column vectors in the matrix. Adding a column of ones (intercept) to a matrix with one-hot encoded columns may introduce linear dependence.
